To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) social network analysis is a valuable tool for understanding HIV/AIDS risk behaviors, (2) the sociometric network structure of risk behaviors is a powerful indicator of risk behaviors and risk for HIV, and (3) the sociometric risk network structure can be used to identify and target individuals for HIV prevention programs.
